title: Mr. Queen
hook: How does Mr. Queen end? The modern chef's soul leaves the Queen's body, the real So-yong wakes up, and Cheoljong reclaims his throne, explained.

sections.heading: Where the body-swap leaves everyone
sections.body: By the finale, Jang Bong-hwan, the brash modern-day Blue House chef whose soul was thrown back to 1851 and trapped inside Queen Kim So-yong, has spent the series upending Joseon court politics from inside her body. The show has slowly revealed that So-yong carried a secret of her own and that King Cheoljong is not the harmless puppet he pretends to be but a man with a darker, calculating side, quietly working to reclaim the power stripped from him by the Grand Queen Dowager and her clan.

sections.heading: The soul returns to the present
sections.body: The final episode, titled My Life Without Me, resolves the supernatural premise. During a violent fight, Bong-hwan has another near-death experience, the mirror of the accident that sent him back in time. This jolt returns his soul to the future and his own body, and at the same instant the real Kim So-yong awakens inside her own body in Joseon. The chaotic two-souls-in-one-vessel arrangement that drove the comedy finally ends, with each consciousness restored to where it belongs across the centuries.

sections.heading: Cheoljong takes back the throne
sections.body: Freed of the political machinery that caged him, King Cheoljong manages to reclaim his position and punish his enemies, breaking the grip of the Grand Queen Dowager's faction. So-yong, now herself again, takes the inner-court power back from the Grand Queen Dowager. The couple weathers a final scare when So-yong nearly suffers a miscarriage but safely pulls through, securing the dynasty's line and clearing the way for the two to rule together on stable ground.

sections.heading: A new era together
sections.body: The drama closes on Cheoljong and So-yong beginning a new ruling era side by side, their partnership now built on genuine love rather than the suspicion and farce of the early episodes. The body-swap that started as pure chaos resolves into a settled royal couple, with Bong-hwan back in the modern world carrying the memory of his strange detour through history. The finale balances its comic premise with a sincere ending, letting both timelines reach a calm, earned resolution.

final_image: King Cheoljong and Queen So-yong stand together at the start of their new reign, the once-chaotic court settled into a loving, stable partnership as the dynasty's future is secured.

lingering_questions.q: Does Jang Bong-hwan return to the present in Mr. Queen?
lingering_questions.a: Yes. After a near-death experience during a fight in the final episode, Bong-hwan's soul returns to the future and his own body, and at the same moment the original Kim So-yong wakes up in her own body in Joseon.

lingering_questions.q: What happens to Cheoljong and So-yong at the end?
lingering_questions.a: Cheoljong reclaims his throne and punishes his enemies while So-yong takes back inner-court power from the Grand Queen Dowager. After a miscarriage scare she recovers safely, and the couple begin a new ruling era together.
